responsibility: Drives the end-to-end Graphite loop-transformation pass over a function. It prepares loop and dominance information, canonicalizes loop form for SCoP discovery, creates the shared isl context and scalar-evolution cache, invokes SCoP detection, polyhedral construction, isl schedule optimization, and AST-to-GIMPLE regeneration for each candidate region, then repairs SSA/loop form and cleans up CFG/profile state after successful changes. It also defines the pass objects and gating logic that enable Graphite when identity, loop-parallelization, or loop-nest-optimization flags are active.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable Graphite pass driver and pass objects: it orchestrates loop canonicalization, SCoP discovery, isl context setup, polyhedral build/transform/regeneration, and post-transform SSA/CFG cleanup. Unlike gcc/graphite.h, which defines the shared Graphite data structures and cross-file APIs, this file performs the end-to-end pass execution for a function.
